answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is slashed if its actions violate a challengeable rule, with disputes resolved by a randomly selected, stake-weighted jury. A sybil attacker can create many identities, but cannot multiply influence cheaply: each one needs capital locked up, and coordinated false claims risk losing the bonds. The ledge, lotus, and karst accounts may look unrelated, yet they face the same costly verification and penalty, so splitting one attacker across names buys little without tying up more funds.
